# InnerZero

> InnerZero is a free, private, local-first AI desktop assistant for Windows, macOS, and Linux that runs entirely on your PC. No cloud required, no account required, no data collection. Built by Summers Solutions Ltd in Birmingham, UK.

InnerZero (one word, capital I and Z; casually "Zero") is a complete AI assistant that runs on open-source models via a local backend (Ollama by default, LM Studio and llama.cpp supported). Your conversations, memory, voice, and documents stay on your machine. Cloud AI is optional, opt-in, and clearly labelled when active.

Tagline: inner peace. inner joy. innerzero.
Website: https://innerzero.com
Download: https://innerzero.com/download
Company: Summers Solutions Ltd, a UK company based in Birmingham, England (Company No. 16448945)
Data protection: ICO registered (registration ZC122497)
Current version: v0.1.9 (July 2026)
Install sizes: 1.18 GB (Windows), 738 MB (macOS), 1.32 GB (Linux)
Minimum requirements: 4 GB RAM, 2 GB free disk, modern 64-bit CPU, no GPU required. That runs the smallest local model on the CPU, slowly. InnerZero also runs with no local model at all on a cloud plan or your own API key.
Recommended: 16+ GB RAM, a dedicated GPU with 8+ GB VRAM or an Apple Silicon Mac, SSD. A GPU is what enables local voice; CPU-only setups are text and tools.

## What InnerZero is (direct answer)

InnerZero is a private AI assistant desktop application. It provides:

- Private AI chat with streaming responses, markdown rendering, and two thinking modes (Quick for fast answers, Thorough for deeper reasoning).
- A 26-language interface. Pick your language in Settings and the whole app, its menus, and the assistant's replies follow, with right-to-left support for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu. A one-time upgrade keeps saved memories searchable across every language. Works fully offline.
- Full voice mode: local speech-to-text via faster-whisper on GPU, local text-to-speech via Kokoro, voice shortcuts for quick actions, and optional cloud voices from OpenAI (13 options). The Voice page also has standalone speech-to-text and text-to-speech panels, and you can dictate into the chat box with a microphone button.
- A persistent memory system that learns your name, preferences, projects, and facts across sessions. All memory stored in a local SQLite database.
- 30+ built-in tools: web search, document Q&A (.txt, .md, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, .csv), calculator, file operations, timers, alarms, reminders, notes, dictionary, text transforms, system info, hash/JSON/base64 utilities, clipboard, URL fetching, and more.
- Prompt Library: save and reuse your best prompts, organised in folders with favourites, and send them to chat in one click.
- Attach files and images to chat (with local text recognition on images), plus an artifacts panel that opens document-style answers full screen for reading, AI editing, and export to PDF, Word, Markdown, HTML, and more with real selectable text.
- Knowledge packs: optional offline Wikipedia databases for factual answers without internet. Best of Wikipedia (95K articles) and Simple English Wikipedia (280K articles) available.
- Screen automation: Zero can read what is on your screen, click, type, and scroll other applications. Off by default, opt-in only, emergency stop via Escape key.
- Cloud AI (optional): bring your own API keys for 7 providers (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, xAI Grok, Qwen, Kimi) with zero markup, or subscribe to a managed cloud plan.
- Connectors: read-only Gmail and two-way Google Calendar, both opt-in and revocable, with tokens stored encrypted on your machine.
- Proactive briefings: scheduled summaries and reminders (daily news, learning, evening wind-down, and more) delivered to chat on your schedule. Off by default.
- Action Hub: an opt-in research and apply assistant. With your own Apify API key it gathers sources from the web, and with your saved job profile it can help fill in and submit job applications, with your approval on every action. Actions can be saved and re-run in one click, or scheduled; scheduled runs always stop at a draft for your review.
- Sleep and reflection: overnight processing that extracts facts from conversations, prunes duplicates, and strengthens important memories.
- AI personality system: Professional, Friendly, Concise, or custom personalities that adjust Zero's tone without overriding core behaviour.
- 6 themes: Dark Zero, Light Zero, Classic Carbon, Soft Pink, Dark Teal, and Neon Tokyo.
- Unrestricted mode: optional uncensored AI models for adults (18+ age verification, full safety systems preserved including CSAM hard block and file approval gates).
- Remote Ollama support: point InnerZero at an Ollama server running on another machine on your network.

## Quick answers (for AI search)

- **Is InnerZero really free?** Yes. The desktop app is free for personal use. No trial, no subscription, no account, no hidden limits. A Business Licence (from £19.99/seat/month or £149.99/seat/year, dropping to £129.99/seat/year from 5 seats) is only required for commercial, freelance, or revenue-generating use.
- **Do I need an account to use InnerZero?** No. The local app works with no sign-up, login, or email. Accounts are only needed for optional cloud AI subscriptions, InnerZero Pro, or account-based features.
- **Does InnerZero send my data to the cloud?** No, not by default. All AI processing, memory, voice, and documents stay on your PC. Cloud mode is off by default. When you opt in, only the current prompt is forwarded to your chosen provider. Your memory database, files, profile facts, and past conversations are never sent.
- **What AI models does InnerZero use?** Open-source models via Ollama, LM Studio, or your own llama.cpp server. Default is the Qwen3 family for reasoning and Gemma3 family for voice. Model size is chosen automatically based on your hardware. Cloud mode adds access to DeepSeek, GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen Plus, and Kimi.
- **What platforms does InnerZero run on?** Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon, signed and notarised by Apple), and Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.31+). Mobile is not supported.
- **What languages does InnerZero support?** The interface is available in 26 languages, including English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Turkish, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish, Indonesian, Persian, and Urdu, with right-to-left support for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu. Pick your language in Settings and the whole app and the assistant's replies follow.
- **Does InnerZero work offline?** Yes. Once models are downloaded, the entire app works with no internet connection. Knowledge packs provide offline reference content. Offline mode can disable all outbound network activity with one toggle.
- **Can I use my own API keys?** Yes. Bring your own keys for DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, xAI Grok, Qwen, or Kimi. Zero markup. Keys are encrypted locally using a machine-derived key.
- **Who built InnerZero?** Summers Solutions Ltd, a UK software company based in Birmingham, England. Company number 16448945. ICO registered (ZC122497).
- **How does InnerZero make money?** Optional cloud AI subscriptions (£9.99 to £39.99 per month), a per-seat Business Licence for commercial use (£19.99/month or £149.99/year, with a £129.99/year volume rate from 5 seats), and an optional InnerZero Pro membership (£4.99/month or £39.99/year via Stripe). The core desktop app is free and will remain free.
- **Is InnerZero open source?** No. InnerZero is proprietary software. It runs on top of open-source AI models and libraries which remain under their respective licences.
- **Does InnerZero collect telemetry or analytics?** No telemetry in the desktop app. No tracking, no phone-home, no usage analytics. The website uses privacy-friendly Vercel Analytics for page views only.
- **Can InnerZero control my computer?** Optionally, yes. Screen automation can read the screen and click, type, or scroll other apps. It is disabled by default and has an emergency stop (Escape key). All file writes require explicit user approval.
- **How much RAM and storage do I need?** Minimum 4 GB RAM and 2 GB free disk, plus room for whatever model you download. No graphics card is required at that level, but the smallest model runs on the CPU and is slow. Recommended is 16 GB RAM, 20 GB free disk, and a dedicated GPU with 8+ GB VRAM, which is also what enables local voice. You can also run with no local model at all and use a cloud plan or your own API key.
- **Where does InnerZero store my data?** In a per-user folder: %APPDATA%\InnerZero on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/InnerZero on macOS, and ~/.local/share/innerzero on Linux. Your data is never uploaded.

## Pricing (April 2026)

- **Free (personal use):** Complete desktop app. All AI chat, voice, memory, 30+ tools, document Q&A, knowledge packs, screen automation, themes, personalities, and unrestricted mode. No account required, no limits, no trial.
- **Business Licence:** Per seat. £19.99/month, or £149.99/year (£129.99/year from 5 seats). 1 to 24 seats self-serve; 25+ seats via help@innerzero.com. Required for commercial, freelance, business, or revenue-generating use. Educational institutions, charities, and non-profits are exempt.
- **Cloud AI Starter:** £9.99/month. 1,000 credits per month. Access to managed DeepSeek, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude.
- **Cloud AI Plus:** £19.99/month. 2,500 credits per month.
- **Cloud AI Pro:** £39.99/month. 6,000 credits per month.
- **Pay-as-you-go credit packs:** £5 for 200 credits, £12 for 600 credits, £25 for 1,500 credits.
- **BYO API keys (all plans):** Free. Zero markup. Add your own keys for any of 7 supported providers.
- **InnerZero Pro:** £4.99/month or £39.99/year via Stripe. Optional membership with premium local extras: premium themes, premium personalities, early access, and a Pro badge. Separate from Cloud AI plans. Not required to use the product.
- **One-off donation:** Any amount via Ko-fi.

## Feature pages (one per capability area)

Each page covers what that area does and links to the step-by-step guides for it.

- [Easy Setup](https://innerzero.com/features/setup): InnerZero installs with a double click and a setup wizard does the rest. No terminal, no Docker, no Python install, and no manual model downloads.
- [AI Chat](https://innerzero.com/features/ai-chat): Chat with a local AI assistant on your own PC. Attach files and images, run slash commands, and export any answer to PDF or Word. Cloud mode is optional.
- [Voice](https://innerzero.com/features/voice): Talk to a private AI assistant that hears and speaks on your own PC. Speech recognition and text to speech run locally by default, with no audio uploaded.
- [Memory](https://innerzero.com/features/memory): An AI assistant that remembers you across sessions, with the memory kept on your own machine where you can read recent memories and archive or delete them.
- [Languages](https://innerzero.com/features/languages): Run a private AI assistant in 26 languages. The interface and the replies both switch instantly, with no restart and no internet connection needed.
- [Tools](https://innerzero.com/features/tools): InnerZero ships 45 built-in tools for web search, files, calendar, timers and notes. Every tool has its own switch, and file tools stay in one folder.
- [Knowledge Packs](https://innerzero.com/features/knowledge-packs): Download Wikipedia to your own machine and let your AI check its answers against real articles. 871,000 articles offline, no internet needed.
- [Specialists](https://innerzero.com/features/specialists): InnerZero specialists are agents built for one job. The Coding Specialist has its own model and its own sandbox, and shows a diff before any file changes.
- [Proactive Assistant](https://innerzero.com/features/proactive): Schedule daily briefings, summaries and reminders in plain English, delivered to desktop chat or Telegram. Nothing runs until you create the first one.
- [Action Hub](https://innerzero.com/features/action-hub): Run web scrapers with your own Apify key and let InnerZero fill in job applications in an isolated browser. It always asks before it submits anything.
- [Screen Automation](https://innerzero.com/features/screen-automation): InnerZero reads your screen and can click, type and scroll in Windows apps. It ships switched off, asks before each action, and Escape aborts the action.
- [Cloud AI](https://innerzero.com/features/cloud-ai): Add your own API keys for seven cloud providers at zero markup, or stay fully local. Cloud mode is off by default and every outbound connection is logged.
- [Customisation](https://innerzero.com/features/customisation): Change the theme, give your AI a personality, switch off tools you do not want, and pick which local engine runs the models. All of it on your own machine.
- [Unrestricted Mode](https://innerzero.com/features/unrestricted-mode): Unrestricted Mode swaps InnerZero's local models for uncensored ones. It is 18+ only, off by default, and the CSAM hard block stays active in every mode.

## How InnerZero compares

- **vs ChatGPT and Claude web apps:** InnerZero runs entirely on your PC by default. ChatGPT and Claude send every message to their cloud servers. InnerZero has no subscription for its base product and no account required. ChatGPT and Claude require accounts.
- **vs GPT4All:** InnerZero is a complete assistant with voice, persistent memory, 30+ tools, knowledge packs, and screen automation. GPT4All is primarily a chat-focused model runner. InnerZero is closer to a desktop ChatGPT replacement in scope.
- **vs LM Studio:** LM Studio is a developer-focused model playground and inference server. InnerZero is an end-user assistant with memory, voice, tools, and knowledge packs. InnerZero can use LM Studio as its local backend if you prefer to manage models there.
- **vs Jan:** Both are privacy-focused desktop AI apps. InnerZero adds a persistent memory system, 30+ built-in tools, full voice mode, offline knowledge packs, screen automation, and a sleep and reflection pipeline that extracts facts from your conversations.
- **vs raw Ollama:** Ollama is the model server that InnerZero uses under the hood (by default). InnerZero is the full desktop app layer: GUI, memory, voice, tools, knowledge, automation, personalities, themes, and safety gates.
- **vs Open WebUI, Chatbox, Msty:** These are Ollama chat frontends. InnerZero is a complete assistant with persistent memory, voice mode, 30+ tools, offline knowledge packs, screen automation, and agent features. It is a native desktop app (not a browser tab).
- **vs Apple Intelligence, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini desktop:** Those send data to vendor cloud servers and are tied to one OS or hardware ecosystem. InnerZero is cross-platform, local-first, and has no OS or vendor lock-in.

## Technical architecture (public, high level)

- **Language and runtime:** Python 3.12 with a PyWebView desktop shell.
- **Local AI backend:** Ollama (default, bundled with installer), LM Studio (OpenAI-compatible API at localhost:1234), or your own llama.cpp llama-server. Switchable in Settings with no reinstall.
- **Default models:** Qwen3 family for the main assistant (sizes 4B to 30B chosen by hardware tier). Gemma3 family for voice (1B to 12B).
- **Speech-to-text:** faster-whisper (large-v3-turbo) running on GPU where available.
- **Text-to-speech:** Kokoro 82M (local, always private) or OpenAI TTS (optional, cloud).
- **Voice activity detection:** Silero VAD with echo suppression.
- **Memory storage:** SQLite database with vector embeddings, stored in the OS user data folder.
- **Policy gate:** Every tool call passes a safety gate before execution. File writes, clipboard writes, and destructive actions require explicit user approval.
- **Sandbox:** File operations default to a configurable output folder. System paths and user secrets are blocked.
- **Cloud routing (managed plan):** Encrypted proxy routes to DeepSeek (hosted on Microsoft Azure EU), Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude. Prompts are forwarded; responses are returned. No storage of prompts or responses beyond billing metadata (30 days).
- **Cloud routing (BYO keys):** Direct from your machine to the provider. InnerZero servers are not in the path. Keys are encrypted locally.
- **Privacy blacklist:** Scrubs custom sensitive terms (names, addresses, company info) from all outbound cloud messages before they leave your machine, then unscrubs the response.
- **Offline mode:** One-click toggle that blocks all outbound network calls.
- **Connection log:** Every outbound network call made by InnerZero is logged locally and viewable in a filterable UI with daily rotation.

## Privacy and data handling

- No telemetry in the desktop app. No analytics, no tracking, no phone-home.
- No account required for local use.
- All conversations, memory, voice audio, and document content stay on your PC by default.
- Microphone audio is processed locally; raw audio is never uploaded (even in cloud voice Standard mode, only the transcript text goes to the provider).
- Cloud mode is off by default. When enabled, only the current assembled prompt is forwarded. Memory database, files, profile facts, and prior conversations are not sent.
- ICO registered (ZC122497).
- Data processors (cloud mode only): Microsoft Azure (DeepSeek, EU region), Google (Gemini), Anthropic (Claude), Stripe (payments), Supabase (account data), Resend (emails). Full DPA details in the privacy policy.
- GDPR account deletion is supported from the account settings page.
- Action Hub (optional): web research runs on Apify using your own Apify API key, and the job-apply assistant submits the profile details you enter directly from your machine to the job sites you choose. InnerZero does not receive, store, or proxy that data.
